d: Satellite Imagery analysed by the International Institute for Strategic Studies (IISS) has released images taken by Vantor satellites over Russian missile base in Dombarovsky. The images show heavy military activity around an underground missile silo pointing to a possible launch of the RS-28 Sarmat Nuclear-Capable Intercontinental Ballistic Missile. The images show large trucks used for transporting missiles, erect missile loaders and the open hatch of an underground missile silo.
